prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Listen to Your Pet's Reactions", "Hear how your companion responds when happy, curious, or playful."]
1: ["Master Your Desktop Companion", "Learn the essential shortcuts and clicks to summon, interact with, and manage your pet anytime.", "Desktop Shortcuts & Command Guide"]
2: ["Signing in securely links your companion to your account so your pet progress is saved upon re-logging."]
3: ["Find Your Ideal Companion Vibe", "Select how active or quiet you want your desktop pet to be while you work."]
4: ["Set Your Companion's Daily Schedule", "Choose when your desktop companion plays, rests, or keeps you company during work hours."]
5: ["Photo Quality Checklist for Custom Pets", "Follow these tips so your custom companion renders cleanly on your desktop.", "Ensure bright front lighting with centered face framing"]
6: ["If your pet doesn't appear on screen immediately, verify desktop overlay permissions in your OS settings."]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate Unlocked", "Your companion is officially registered and ready to move onto your desktop environment.", "Verified Desktop Companion"]
8: ["Meet Your New Desktop Friend", "See how your pet roams your desktop, responds to clicks, and keeps you active during work."]
9: ["Quick tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to access quick controls, speech options, or hide settings."]
